rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for food to eat, including a type or item of food.

example.english: The food at this cha chaan teng is really good value.
example.traditional: 呢間茶記啲嘢食好抵食。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 gei3 dik1 je5 sik6 hou2 dai2 sik6

rows.note: Use this formal or written term when referring generally to food or a foodstuff, especially as a category.

example.english: Food safety is very important to everyone.
example.traditional: 食物安全對大家都好重要。
example.jyutping: sik6 mat6 on1 cyun4 deoi3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3
